desc: A trillion souls live on $marketName, more than Old Earth ever held, even at the height of the Domain.

name: Population
desc: $MarketName houses tens of trillions. Every surface is built over, and the city goes as far down as it goes up.

name: Population
desc: Hundreds of trillions live on $marketName. Its own people need a lifetime to learn their way around it.

name: Population
desc: $MarketName holds a quadrillion lives. The Omega core that runs it is the only mind in the Sector that can keep count.

name: Arcology World
desc: Arcologies kilometres tall have swallowed $marketName's old cities whole. What land is left between them is kept as parkland, because nothing else is needed there.

name: Ecumenopolis
desc: $MarketName is a single city from pole to pole. Its oceans run through pipes, its weather is scheduled, and its sky is lit all night by its own streets.
